critical_code_review_comments: CameraScanner.onScan sets lockUntil to +60s during async processing then reduces to +1s after feedback - this is deliberate to prevent duplicate scans mid-process. Looks correct.
Modal Escape handler correctly checks document.querySelectorAll('.modal-backdrop') last entry so nested cropper modal closes before outer edit modal.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded members (Bima MB-2024001, Siti MB-2024002, Raka MB-2024003). Note: tests created real visit records for Bima and Siti on today's date, and uploaded a cropped photo for the first edited member (reverting photos was not required per request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three requested features (visitor name search, camera cooldown feedback, photo cropper) verified end-to-end in headless browser. Camera visual feedback overlay (data-state=ok) could not be verified via QR injection; verified code-level logic only.
